import numpy as np

R,G,B = im[...,0],im[...,1],im[...,2]
# red apple mask
red = (R>120)&(R-G>50)&(R-B>50)
orange = (R>150)&(G>60)&(G<170)&(B<90)&(R-B>80)&(R-G>30)
yellow = (R>170)&(G>150)&(B<120)&(np.abs(R-G)<70)
from scipy import ndimage
for name,m in [('red',red),('orange',orange),('yellow',yellow)]:
    lab,n = ndimage.label(m)
    objs = ndimage.find_objects(lab)
    comps=[]
    for i,s in enumerate(objs,1):
        area=(lab[s]==i).sum()
        if area>40:
            ys,xs=s
            cy,cx=ndimage.center_of_mass(m,lab,i)
            comps.append((area,round(cx,1),round(cy,1),xs.start,xs.stop,ys.start,ys.stop))
    comps.sort(reverse=True)
    print(name, comps[:12])
EOF"
